narration.text: When I was ten, everyone in Little Ridge said the hill was just a hill.
Papa couldn't come home for the Bell Festival. Again.
Nani said the bell was Grandpa's. He found it on top of the hill, a long time ago.
So I climbed to the top, where the city lights look closest.
And I rang it, as hard as I could.
I should have run. But he didn't look angry. He looked... lonely. Like me.
The next morning... the hill was gone.
